verdict.rationale: Gecko's documented capability is source-to-sink code vulnerability detection (SAST-style) with a generic 'Request fix' PR mechanism for findings it detects in application code; there is no evidence of dependency/package manifest scanning, CVE-to-package matching, or specific upgrade-path recommendations for vulnerable dependencies (SCA). Missing for 10: any mention of software composition analysis, dependency manifest parsing, package version resolution, or upgrade-path guidance tied to third-party library CVEs.
